source.instruction: Создать блок изменения веса по аналогии с принятым переносом, самостоятельно продумать сценарий и опубликовать после независимой проверки координатора.
source.independent_gate: ROOT PASS for empty, filled, 72 ID, NULL/0, missing ID, confirmation, cancel/reopen, responsive and canonical classes; publication explicitly commanded after transfer PR #452 merge.

scope: /erpv2/company/feo/requests/weights — create, editor, read-only detail and final revert confirmation

approved.shell: The exact shared modal shell: IBM Plex Sans title 19/700/22, #131210, cross right; #F0EDE6 header/footer; 48px footer, #DEDAD0 divider; #FEFDF8 body with 12/16px padding and 8px grid. Existing shared backdrop. No local popup skin.
approved.create: No editable block name or comment. Requests textarea 96px, vertically resizable, six-digit ID placeholder. Paste extracts first Excel/markdown column and normalizes visible IDs to comma-separated text. Current weights load automatically after 250ms, with stale response discard. Footer has Отменить and one primary Сохранить изменения веса; save disabled without current preview token.
approved.editor: Plain summary Заявок: N. and optional Повторов объединено: D. Shared 1px bordered compact table, max-height 300px internal scroll: Заявка / Нетто было / Нетто станет, кг / Брутто было / Брутто станет, кг. Current values come from feo_requests, converted tonnes to kg. Numeric input allows nonnegative kilograms with 0.1 precision; blank means NULL/delete, while 0 remains a real weight. Only changed requests are stored in a block.
approved.validation: Unknown six-digit IDs are listed under Requests in system dark red #872822 with role=alert. Invalid kilograms and unchanged-weight error appear under the editor table, using the same shared field-error role. No separate Проверить or Загрузить button. Server preview and create keep stale-state checks.
approved.detail: Title Изменение веса №ID. Plain read-only text lists every request number in shared 12/700 tabular-numeric role, followed by Заявок: N. and the same bordered table with before/after net and gross. NULL is a neutral dash, zero is 0 кг. No block/author/comment/return metadata strip. Footer has Отменить and Отменить изменение веса for an applied block; returned block has only Отменить.
approved.confirmation: Same shell and title. Plain text lists all IDs and says they return to previous net and gross; second line explains that a later weight change stops the entire return and history remains. Footer has Отменить and shared red .btn-danger Отменить изменение веса. Cancel/reopen restores ordinary primary action. Server failure appears below the text, dark red with role=alert.
approved.responsive: The five-column table scrolls only inside its bordered region at narrow widths. Dialog/document have no accidental horizontal overflow; all footer actions remain reachable.

business_contract: Existing FeoWeightBatchService retains independent nullable net/gross, 0 versus NULL, atomic create/revert, stale current-value checks, legacy sync and MAX notification. The new view does not change the seven-column main registry table or its data/filters.

implementation.style: public/assets/css/registry-components.css; shared rules inherited from merged transfer PR #452, no weight-specific copies

excluded: Changing the main seven-column weight history registry
Approving new palette colors or one-page lookalike classes
